Name: Garden Grass
Author: oomps62
Description:
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to replace the grass. There are two versions: [b]long[/b] and [b]short[/b], which are mostly the same, but the height of the grass is different. The flowers are blue/white in the spring, purple/pink in the summer, and burgundy in the fall.

To install this mod, download the file you'd like, unzip the file, rename the folder to GardenGrass, and add GardenGrass into the mods folder. Remember that this mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=posts]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.

Feel free to edit for your personal use, but please don't redistribute. This is the only official place to download this mod.
